jpmprivatebank2026.author: JPMorgan Chase
jpmprivatebank2026.title: J.P. Morgan Private Bank Asia: Legal Disclaimer
jpmprivatebank2026.read_scope: Asia legal-entity, service-provider and regulator paragraphs; adjacent Europe and Switzerland entity disclosures.
jpmprivatebank2026.support: Identifies JPMCB Hong Kong/Singapore branches for specified services as notified to the client, US national-bank charter and Hong Kong supervision; different jurisdictions have different entities.
jpmprivatebank2026.limitations: Public disclosure does not identify the user's account or supply internal bank policy. The year is the retrieval year.

ofacuspersons2024.author: Office of Foreign Assets Control
ofacuspersons2024.title: FAQ 11: Who must comply with OFAC sanctions?
ofacuspersons2024.read_scope: Complete substantive answer, updated 21 August 2024, including program-specific foreign-subsidiary examples.
ofacuspersons2024.support: US persons include foreign branches of US entities; some programs cover foreign subsidiaries; non-US persons can face specified obligations. Definitions must be checked per program.
ofacuspersons2024.limitations: No blanket rule for all affiliates or all transactions is inferred.

eo140322021.author: President of the United States
eo140322021.title: Executive Order 14032: Addressing the Threat from Securities Investments that Finance Certain Companies of the People's Republic of China
eo140322021.read_scope: Complete five-page order, especially replacement sections 1--3, authorizations, evasion, definitions, revocation and annex.
eo140322021.support: Defines covered purchases/sales, designation conditions, effective dates, divestment periods and authorizations; includes foreign branches in the US-person definition. State ownership or the AT1 label alone is not the specified prohibition test.
eo140322021.limitations: Historical legal instrument interpreted with retained OFAC guidance; no claim of complete subsequent amendments or live designation screening.

ofaccmicservices2021.author: Office of Foreign Assets Control
ofaccmicservices2021.title: FAQ 902: Investment services for non-US persons under EO 13959, as amended
ofaccmicservices2021.read_scope: Complete substantive answer and fund-manager example, including ultimate benefit and evasion qualifications.
ofaccmicservices2021.support: Specified advisory/management services for non-US persons may be permissible when the underlying trade does not otherwise violate the order. The bank and ultimate party are separate applicability inputs.
ofaccmicservices2021.limitations: Does not authorize a bank's principal purchases or establish every transaction involving a non-US customer as permissible.

ofaccmicintermediation2022.author: Office of Foreign Assets Control
ofaccmicintermediation2022.title: FAQ 1048: Rejection and intermediation of CMIC securities transactions
ofaccmicintermediation2022.read_scope: Complete substantive answer, including rejection/reporting and non-US intermediation sentences.
ofaccmicintermediation2022.support: The specified order does not require blocking, but prohibited trades must be rejected and reported. Specified transactions between non-US persons can still be intermediated by US financial institutions.
ofaccmicintermediation2022.limitations: Separate blocking programs and other legal restrictions remain relevant; implementation does not automatically submit reports or freeze assets.

ofaccmicholding2022.author: Office of Foreign Assets Control
ofaccmicholding2022.title: FAQ 1046: Holding and divestment of CMIC securities
ofaccmicholding2022.support: Continued holding is allowed under this order after the divestment period; subsequent purchases/sales require authorization.
ofaccmicholding2022.limitations: Not a conclusion about another sanctions regime or all corporate actions.

ofaccmicdates2021.author: Office of Foreign Assets Control
ofaccmicdates2021.title: FAQ 899: Designated entities and effective dates under EO 13959, as amended
ofaccmicdates2021.read_scope: Complete substantive answer, list replacement, exact names and prohibition/divestment dates.
ofaccmicdates2021.support: Designation-specific identity and timing matter; original annex entities and later designated entities have specified timing rules.
ofaccmicdates2021.limitations: This FAQ is not a live issuer-list snapshot or an entity identity resolver.

ofacownership2014.author: Office of Foreign Assets Control
ofacownership2014.title: FAQ 401: Indirect ownership under OFAC's 50 Percent Rule
ofacownership2014.read_scope: Complete substantive answer and all five ownership examples.
ofacownership2014.support: Blocked intermediate entities transmit the 50 percent ownership consequence; blocked direct stakes aggregate. An unblocked minority-owned intermediate is not treated as fully blocked.
ofacownership2014.limitations: The local fixed-point derivation formalizes supplied affirmative stakes; it does not establish actual ownership, identity, control-based designation or completeness.

ofaccmicsubs2021.author: Office of Foreign Assets Control
ofaccmicsubs2021.title: FAQ 857: Subsidiaries under the Chinese military-industrial securities restrictions
ofaccmicsubs2021.read_scope: Complete substantive answer, including independent designation and timing.
ofaccmicsubs2021.support: A subsidiary must itself be designated; the OFAC 50 percent rule does not apply solely because an entity is NS-CMIC-listed.
ofaccmicsubs2021.limitations: Does not exclude separate blocking sanctions or indirect covered-security exposure rules.

occbsa2025.author: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
occbsa2025.title: 12 CFR 21.21: Procedures for monitoring Bank Secrecy Act compliance, 2025 edition
occbsa2025.read_scope: Section 21.21(a)--(d) across printed pages 589--590; surrounding sections excluded from the claim.
occbsa2025.support: National-bank written BSA program, customer identification, internal controls, independent testing, responsible individuals and training.
occbsa2025.limitations: Retained annual 2025 edition; current eCFR text inspected through the web tool matched the cited program provisions, but the downloaded access page is rejected. No blanket extraterritorial application of every account rule.

fincenprivatebankdef2025.author: Financial Crimes Enforcement Network
fincenprivatebankdef2025.title: 31 CFR 1010.605: Definitions for correspondent and private banking accounts, 2025 edition
fincenprivatebankdef2025.read_scope: Definitions in section 1010.605, especially (e), (h), (m) and (p), printed pages 1157--1159.
fincenprivatebankdef2025.support: Private-banking-account definition requires the minimum aggregate assets, specified non-US ownership and institutional liaison; connected definitions have their own scope.
fincenprivatebankdef2025.limitations: Historical annual edition, not complete 2026 currentness. The commercial private-bank label is not the legal definition. No machine implementation of this provision is claimed.

fincenprivatebankdd2025.author: Financial Crimes Enforcement Network
fincenprivatebankdd2025.title: 31 CFR 1010.620: Due diligence programs for private banking accounts, 2025 edition
fincenprivatebankdd2025.read_scope: Complete section 1010.620(a)--(e), printed pages 1162--1163; following correspondent-account rule excluded.
fincenprivatebankdd2025.support: US establishment/maintenance/administration/management scope; identification, political-figure, funds and activity diligence; special procedures for inability to perform diligence.
fincenprivatebankdd2025.limitations: Historical annual edition, not complete 2026 currentness. Requires the defined institution/account and territorial facts; it is not assigned automatically to a Hong Kong account. No full AML rule implementation is claimed.
